meta.game: Beneath the Mask - MBTI prediction party game
meta.authoring_rule: Every option is a miniature characterization of X: observational humour + affectionate roasting + plausible behavior. The joke is SURFACE ONLY. Weights are assigned from the underlying behavior the option describes, never from how funny or serious the option reads. funny != P, serious != J.

selection.shuffle_note: CRITICAL: option order must be re-shuffled per question per round, with the per-player answer mapping stored server-side. Fixed option order lets players memorize which option = which pole.

scoring.group_majority_correct: no bonus - group prediction feeds the 'how your group sees you' reveal only
scoring.winner: most total correct predictions across all rounds
scoring.tie_break: most best-predictor badges, then head-to-head correct answers

meta.type_derivation: sum option weights per pole across the player's 12 answers; letter = pole with higher total per axis; group type = same math on majority-voted options

audit_log.scoring_audit: 11 option weights reassigned after stripping the joke and describing the behavior clinically (joke-carried weights removed)
duplicates_removed: Q37 (backup-plan question was an expanded duplicate of Q17 option B)
rewritten: Q34 replaced: deadline-with-no-oversight duplicate of Q17 -> 'The Invitation' (spontaneous plan-change reaction, a J/P surface that is not planner-vs-procrastinator)
audit_log.resolution_equalization: 25 weights raised 1->2 where the clinical behavior is strongly diagnostic, narrowing per-axis draw-total spread from ~2x to ~1.4x
audit_log.coverage_test: 10,000 random 12-question draws: 0 under-covered (min weight 3 per axis); per-axis draw totals EI~24 SN~21 TF~30 JP~35
kept_with_defense: Q59C 'sends clone to meetings' -> P2 I1: choosing absence while obligations are covered = disengagement from scheduled structure + group-setting avoidance; survives clinical description

functions.role: interpretation layer only - axes remain the sole type estimator
functions.anti_circularity: options carry behavioral constructs only. Function evidence is DERIVED from constructs via this table, never assigned directly to an option. An option therefore can never be its own evidence for a function.
functions.process: answer -> behavioral constructs -> behavior_to_function mapping (confidence-graded) -> function evidence profile -> reveal analysis

solitude-preference.note: do not over-read; primary evidence is the I axis

impulse-follow.note: generic P behavior; weak function evidence by design

flexibility-tolerance.note: generic P behavior; do not over-read

external-input-seeking.note: trust, Fe, and low confidence are all possible motives; none are observed

functions.reveal_analyzer: when group type != self type: for each flipped axis, take questions where the majority vote != X's answer; collect the BEHAVIORAL constructs of X's actual picks vs the group's predicted picks; derive function evidence via behavior_to_function; render the disagreement in process language WITH its confidence ('the group read your behavior as systematic-execution (Te-leaning); your answers actually pattern possibility-exploration + values-driven-choice (Ne/Fi-leaning, moderate confidence)')

support_layers_future.big_five: future support layer: openness/extraversion/agreeableness/conscientiousness facets cross-check the axis profile
support_layers_future.enneagram: future support layer: motivational patterns cross-check the function profile
support_layers_future.rule: NEVER auto-override the MBTI result. On conflict, report it: 'INTP - moderate confidence; behavioral evidence partially conflicts'. The conflict itself is a feature: it drives the most interesting reveal moments.

functions.rule_v6: observable-behavior-first: text -> observable behavior -> construct(s) -> possible functions. No construct because it 'resembles' a function. No Fe because kind, no Ti because thinking, no Si because familiar, no Se because fast, no Ne because imaginative. If a response cannot distinguish functions -> non-diagnostic. One behavior may feed several functions. Some behaviors feed mainly the axes, not the functions.
functions.construct_vs_motive: a behavioral construct is NOT a psychological motive. Example: 'X asks five people before buying' OBSERVES external-input-seeking. It does NOT observe 'X trusts others', 'X is Fe', 'X lacks confidence', or 'X seeks harmony'. Those could explain the behavior; they are not observed. The dni field exists to block exactly these leaps.

option_schema.w: axis weights - the ONLY type estimator
option_schema.fn: DERIVED function evidence (from b via behavior_to_function; highest confidence per function wins). Never authored directly.
option_schema.dni: do-not-infer list: conclusions this option does NOT license
option_schema.alt: alternative non-MBTI explanations (context, habit, training, circumstance)

meta.v7_note: Removed the absurd-hypothetical category (door, superpower, time machine, alien, other decade, zombies, fridge, portal, cat, theme song, ghost, clone, moon) and replaced 13 questions in the proven behavioral registers. Rationale: this is a PREDICTION game — predictors vote from observed real-world history; no one has observed anyone's moon protocol. Absurd scenarios sample self-presentation, not behavior, and add noise to scoring. Kept lottery/elevator/apps (grounded hypotheticals with real-behavior options).
meta.v71_note: Added 3 archetype-habit questions (browser tabs, unread inbox, stationery drawer) — the highest-recognition register: habits friends have actually observed, instantly self-roasting.
meta.v8_note: Architecture v8: added Layer A (family probes, duel=NT/NF/ST/SF) and Layer B (cognitive duels, duel=Ni/Ne, Ti/Te, Fi/Fe, Si/Se). Duel options carry the duel axis only; distractors carry other axes and never pollute the duel axis. Engine v2 required: derive 16-type matrix from fn evidence via stack positions (dominant x2, aux x1.5, tertiary x1, inferior x0.5), sequential information-gain selection, stability index (S1-S2)/(S1+S2), re-probe rule on Layer C, 12-14 questions, confidence display.
meta.v8_family_rule: Family probes: CONSTANT AROUSAL, VARIABLE ATTENTION DIRECTION. Options never describe calm/panic/screaming (physiological arousal is not cognitive style); each option describes where attention goes first when action is required: system/cause (NT), people/values (NF), concrete problem (ST), human context (SF).
meta.v8_scene_rule: Options are FILMABLE SCENES, not mode descriptions: show the action a camera could capture (opens the logs, counts heads, grabs the extinguisher). Never describe the cognitive mode directly (no 'attention goes to', no 'thinks about'). The roast rides inside the scene. Arousal words (calm/panics/screams) stay banned. The hidden weight carries the psychology; the visible text carries the movie.
meta.v81_note: Added 24 IPIP-backed items (src field = IPIP facet lineage, public domain). Method: validated item behavior kept, surface rewritten as filmable scenes in game voice, MBTI weights assigned via the documented Big Five -> MBTI crosswalk (Extraversion->E/I, Openness/ideas->N/S, Agreeableness->F/T, Conscientiousness->J/P; McCrae & Costa 1989). No code change required.

lineage_audit.what: Each non-IPIP question tagged with its nearest validated Big Five facet and link strength (strong/moderate/speculative/none). Tags document construct proximity, NOT validation.
lineage_audit.note: 98/98 questions now carry a documented link to studied constructs: direct IPIP lineage (24), strong/moderate Big Five proximity (55), partial research analogues for the cognitive-function architecture (14: coping orientations, convergent/divergent thinking, self-construal, epistemological reasoning, Kolb, sensation seeking), 0 orphans. The Jungian function constructs themselves remain unvalidated; the duels measure neighboring studied contrasts, not the functions proper.
lineage_audit.final: 100% lineage documented: 32 IPIP-direct items, 22 strong, 33 moderate Big Five proximity, 11 partial research analogues. Zero orphans.
